trigger.description: A strict read fence cannot observe both the addressed database generation and search-index generation. Missing, unreadable, and partially observable stores must refuse retrieval before emitting pack content or stream frames.
setup_commands: # Choose a workspace without an initialized store, or a database whose index generation cannot be observed.

expected_emission.repair_string: Inspect `ee index status` for the same workspace, database and index directory; repair the store or rebuild the index before retrying.
